decision_rule.rule_statement: Adoption requires: peripheral accuracy >= 85% on >= 12 held-out trials, center false activations <= 5% on >= 15 held-out trials, and both passing across >= 2 independent sessions.
decision_rule.relative_advantage_requirement: ResNet-34 requires exceeding MobileOne S0 by >= 15.0 percentage points in addition to meeting all absolute safety gates.

reasons: MOCK report: Synthetic/mock data can never confer adoption or physical validation.
Insufficient independent sessions: 1/2 required across independent sessions.
